text: I use this to motivate myself to be better about hygiene habits like brushing and flossing, as well as logging in my food diary and avoiding snacking. It works very well! I show my partner the reward id like, and I have him come up with the amount of points needed so it feels more fair and not like I'm cheating by setting too low of goals. It also helps my mind be okay with occasional larger purchases, as it requires me to work hard to achieve them.

text: Unfortunately I'm broke so I can't get premium, but this app was exactly what I was looking for - a way to reward and punish myself for habits. There was a feature I was looking for that I had to create a workaround for. I wanted to be able to have both a positive reward for completing a task and a negative reward for not completing it. My workaround was to have 2 habits instead of 1.
